title: Coolify Projects Widget Schema
description: Configuration schema for Coolify Integration: application and service status plus server CPU, memory and storage usage

foldInitially.label: Hide Apps and Services by Default
foldInitially.description: On Widget load, hide all apps and services by default

applicationIds.label: Application IDs
applicationIds.description: Comma separated list of project IDs, if empty, all applications will be in the list

serviceIds.label: Service ID
serviceIds.description: Comma separated list of service IDs, if empty, all services will be in the list

personalAccessToken.label: Personal Access Token With Write Access
personalAccessToken.description: Personal Access Token With Write Access to Redploy and Restart Projects

serverUuid.label: Server UUID (optional)
serverUuid.description: Which Coolify server to report metrics for. Only needed when the token can see more than one server.

sentinelUrl.label: Sentinel URL (optional)
sentinelUrl.description: Coolify Sentinel address for CPU and memory, e.g. http://<coolify-host>:8888. Strongly recommended: discovery derives http://<server-ip>:8888 from the Coolify API, which fails when Sentinel is not published or the server reports host.docker.internal.

sentinelToken.label: Sentinel Token (optional)
sentinelToken.description: Bearer token for Sentinel: the TOKEN env var on the coolify-sentinel container. Strongly recommended over discovery, since Coolify's recorded sentinel_token goes stale if the agent container was recreated after a rotation.

diskPath.label: Storage Paths
diskPath.description: Comma separated list of filesystems to report as storage, one tile each (e.g. /, /home). Read from inside the Mindscape container, since neither Coolify nor Sentinel exposes a disk metric — a path must be visible there, so host directories need a bind mount. Leave empty for /.
